summary: Iteration 6 — Backend-only verification of all four UX fixes for RUT stuck-queue / auto-resume bugs. 22/22 new pytest cases pass in 15.2s + 14/14 iter5 regression still green. All branches of POST /retry validated (failed→OK, stopped→OK, queued+stuck→OK, queued+rc>0→OK, queued+fresh→409 with 'wait 60s' msg, running→409 'stop first', missing-link→400, non-resumable→400, missing-job→404). Auto-resume tolerance is now 10 (server.py:12456 `rc < 10` and 12533 `rc >= 10` confirmed). Failure message says 'Auto-resume gave up after N attempts. Click Retry this job …'. Orphan reaper query at 12437 includes 'preparing'. _set_step helper (server.py:3779-3802) correctly flips status `queued`→`preparing` and writes `prep_step` field on first BG-task tick — verified end-to-end via Mongo read after submit. Live-log `running` flag at real_user_traffic.py:3651 includes 'preparing'. Phase-1 fast submit still <5s (observed ~0.3-1.2s).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 12,606 lines (up from 12,543 at iter5). Continues to grow — strongly recommend splitting into routers (uploads_router.py, rut_router.py, admin_router.py) to stay below ~700 LOC per file. Not blocking but increasing technical-debt risk every iteration.

The retry endpoint (server.py:4754-4830) has good defense-in-depth: it checks status precedence (running > queued/preparing > failed/stopped), then validates is_resumable + submit_params, then re-fetches link. The 60s stuck-threshold + restart_count fallback are well-chosen heuristics. Minor: the 'stuck_seconds = 999' fallback on parse error is a magic number — consider a constant `_STUCK_PARSE_FALLBACK_SECONDS = 999` for clarity.

_set_step() at server.py:3779-3802 wraps DB update + in-memory dict mutation in two separate try/except. Both swallow all exceptions silently. Worth at least a `logger.debug(...)` so a slow-poll-symptomatic issue (prep_step never advancing) can be diagnosed from logs.

Orphan-reaper Case-3 message logic (server.py:12533-12545) currently checks `rc >= 10` BEFORE `not j.get('is_resumable')`. A non-resumable job with rc=10 would get the 'gave up after 10 attempts' message instead of the 'inline files can't be auto-resumed' message — order is correct for the common case but mention the precedence in a comment.

Frontend-side (out of scope per request): RealUserTrafficPage.js shows the prep_step indicator banner (lines 2140-2154) — confirmed present in code but not playwright-verified this iteration since user requested backend-only.
Auto-resume comment at server.py:12508 still says '#{rc + 1}/3' even though tolerance is now 10. Cosmetic-only — not user-visible.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter6 suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_rut_retry_and_preparing.py is the regression gate for the retry/preparing/auto-resume fixes. Run with `pytest backend/tests/test_iteration6_rut_retry_and_preparing.py -v`. The suite uses Mongo-direct mutations (motor) to forcibly age queued_at, set rc>0, force status=running/failed, and orphan link_id — this is necessary because the natural flow can't reproduce these states quickly in a preview env without Playwright. Important gotchas: (a) Some retry-branch tests stop the job first then mutate status because /stop locks status to stopped — this is expected. (b) test_retry_fresh_queued_returns_409 has a soft branch: if the BG task moves the job past queued before the test polls (rare in preview env where Playwright is missing and prep fails fast), the assertion accepts either 409 (queued/preparing) or 200 (failed→retry succeeded). (c) BASE_URL is read from /app/frontend/.env directly via a helper since the python venv doesn't have REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. (d) /api/real-user-traffic/jobs returns {jobs:[...]}, NOT a bare list. (e) The single 'preparing' string-search assertion will break if main agent ever reformats that line (e.g. across multiple lines). If that happens, broaden the regex.
rca_of_the_issue: ALL FOUR FIXES VERIFIED AT RUNTIME. (1) RETRY accepts queued+stuck/rc>0 — test_retry_stuck_queued_via_aging and test_retry_queued_with_rc_gt_zero both PASS with 200+retried:true; test_retry_fresh_queued_returns_409 PASS with 409+'Wait ~60s' message. (2) PREPARING status — test_prep_step_field_in_db PASS: 2s after submit, Mongo doc shows status in (preparing|running|failed) AND prep_step is set OR status has advanced past preparing. is_resumable=true and submit_params persisted. (3) TOLERANCE=10 — static greps for `rc < 10` (line 12456) and `rc >= 10` (line 12533) PASS; failure message contains 'Auto-resume gave up after' and 'Retry this job'. (4) ORPHAN REAPER — static grep confirms query includes 'preparing' (server.py:12437). (5) LIVE-LOG RUNNING — static grep on real_user_traffic.py:3651 confirms 'preparing' in tuple; endpoint smoke returns 200 with running field. (6) EDGE CASES — missing-link → 400 'Original link no longer exists', non-resumable → 400 'not retryable / inline'. (7) PERF — <5s confirmed.
